scope: Unconditional audit of the row-D singleton/cut/double-counting bound and conditional audit of the row-D exclusion using the repaired D17 overlap enumeration; no catalogue-completeness theorem, full order-41 closure, Erdos 151 solution, UNSAT, Git, publication, novelty, or priority claim

binding_policy.rule: This JSON binds the completed audit Markdown and audited inputs but intentionally omits its own hash.

proof_audit.claim: The singleton-fibre cap holds for all five spokes, including a=w in the p and q spokes
proof_audit.reason: The exact bad-ten-set witness is the edge ua. The uv-present case extends it through a; the uv-absent case gives an admissible replacement set. For a=w, removing w also removes the internal edge qw or pw, while U remains anticomplete to M.

proof_audit.claim: Every spoke cut e(U,B_c) is at least 19
proof_audit.reason: Twelve dominated vertices give nonempty neighbour sets, at most five singleton fibres, and incidence at least 5+2*7=19.

proof_audit.claim: r=|N(w) intersect U| is at most seven
proof_audit.reason: w already has the two M-neighbours p and q and Delta(G)<=9.

proof_audit.claim: The shared-w double-counting identity is exact
proof_audit.reason: sum d_U=2e(U)+sum f_c+r=2e(U)+sum e_c-r; the two spoke cuts count each U-w edge twice while the true U-degree sum counts it once.

proof_audit.claim: The global degree budget forces e(U)<=10
The optional Turan lower bound gives e(U)>=9
proof_audit.reason: alpha(U)<=5 makes the 12-vertex complement K6-free, ex(12,K6)=57, and 66-57=9.

proof_audit.claim: Conditional D17 cores have edge range {20,21,22}
proof_audit.reason: The repaired package and independent re-audit enumerate 17 necessary-condition cores. A separate graph6 decoder found edge histogram {20:3,21:9,22:5}.

proof_audit.claim: The analytic upper bound and D17 lower bound are combined without circularity
proof_audit.reason: The overlap filter uses aligned three-fan degrees, a one-unit reserve, forced-w capacity, and r<=7, but not the singleton cap, cut>=19, or e(U)<=10. Reusing r<=7 downstream is not circular.

one_spoke_set_system.method: Dynamic programming over twelve labelled vertices and the 31 nonempty subsets of a five-set with singleton-label capacities

shared_pair_set_system.method: Dynamic programming over the p- and q-spoke neighbour sets with one consistent shared-w bit, two singleton masks, and r<=7
